profile.headline: Front End Developer | Mobile Developer | Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
I love to build with code to solve problems for employers who are interested in creating an inclusive and supportive workspace with a product that benefits society. 

I worked at a small start up for more than four years starting in December 2018 that helps libraries, schools, and employers run reading challenges. I started as the most junior developer and ended my time with the company as the lead mobile developer. I built features and enhancements, and debugged in the front end (AngularJS, Jquery, and React Native) and the back end (Rails) on the main web app and our mobile app. I also built a web app from scratch in React and Rails where I managed deployment on Heroku. 

In my short time as a developer, I have worked as a contractor and a consultant, remotely and in-person, as a mobile developer, full-stack developer and as a UI developer, on teams and by myself. I have used ASP.net, React Native, Django Rest Framework, Vue, Sinatra, React, Rails, and AngularJS. In other words, I have been flexible, and have needed to get up-to-speed quickly with many different languages and processes. Because I love to learn and have a capacity for synthesizing information, I am able to jump quickly into new projects.

I contribute to organizations as an enthusiastic problem solver who brings experience in collaborating in teams, working with many different groups of people, being eager to learn new technologies, and communicating through many mediums.

My education and career experience in teaching bolster my ability to work both with diverse teams and independently.

positions.title: Lead Mobile Developer
positions.description:
Lead mobile app developer (React Native) in charge of a small team 
Solely responsible for creating and integrating the API in the Ruby on Rails monolith
Managed deployment to iOS App Store and Android Google Play Store
Distributed and managed test builds through Firebase

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Architect and write features, enhancements, and bug fixes for B2B web and mobile applications in Rails, React Native, AngularJS, and jQuery. 
Built a web app (and then managed and maintained it) from designer's mocks in Rails and React, deployed on Heroku.  
Connected push notification system using Rails, React Native, and Firebase.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Rebuild client (Highmark Health Solutions) website pages on their member portal with AngularJS. LESS used for CSS. Version control with Git. Task management with RTC.

positions.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Built custom web applications for nonprofits and small businesses with Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and Vue.js.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Git · HTML5 · CSS · REST APIs · Ruby on Rails · Vue

positions.title: Curriculum Developer
positions.description: Used knowledge of computer science concepts, teaching, and GameMaker Studio 2.0 to rewrite and enhance the online curriculum for the Advanced Placement Computer Science Principles course so that Zulama became an endorsed provider recommended by the College Board for the AP exam.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Independent contractor as part of a three person developer team
•	Responsible for building an MVP of a web app for GS National Insurance
•	Building front end and back end
•	App is meant to allow agents and agencies to track their own statistics related to sales, production, participation in contests as well as integrate information sent from Wordpress sites and app administrators
•	Ruby on Rails API back end, React (a JavaScript library) front end, PostgreSQL, front-end testing with Jest, back-end testing with Rspec, version control with Git and Github, project management with Asana, Docker
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Git · jQuery · HTML5 · CSS · REST APIs

company.name: Work Hard Pittsburgh - @workhardpgh/ GS National Insurance

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Available for Android and iOS: academypgh.com/replayfx-companion-app/
•	Independent contractor responsible for design and development of a mobile scheduling app for the Replay FX convention (attended by 10,000 people) in both front end and back end.
•	One of two front-end developers in React Native (a JavaScript library) also using ES-6, JSX, Axios, Lodash, Yarn, and JSON.
•	Completed back-end engineering using  .net/ C#/ MVC/ ASP.net / Microsoft SQL Server and the Entity Framework on Visual Studio to provide RESTful services.
•	Added ability to populate data in back end through calls to a third-party XML API and save (and retrieve) images (from) to an Azure bucket
•	Displays the convention schedule in tabs by day and event type and the games available, with modals for additional information, through API calls using Axios.
•	Allows users to save, display, and receive push notifications (based on timing) for their favorite events.
•	Use Android Studio and Xcode for debugging.
•	Version control using git and GitHub
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Git · CSS · REST APIs

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description: Website optimization for FlexableCare, a start-up that just completed the Alpha Lab incubator. The company was planning to transition from a WordPress site to a custom site using JAVA, SQL, and Vue.js. Assisted primarily with coding front-end pieces such as PayPal integration, displaying results of API calls, and creating pages and components relevant to the needs of the product, such as todo and event pages.

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
ATTENDED TWELVE WEEK CODING BOOTCAMP, ACADEMY PITTSBURGH TO LEARN FULL-STACK DEVELOPMENT
•	Built many projects and apps using a variety of languages, frameworks, and methods
•	Developed a mobile conference schedule app for Replay FX, which is attended by 10,000 people, within a team of six, using React Native 
•	Wrote a variety of programs in C# and Ruby with tests including Conway’s Game of Life, cash register conversion, battleship, etc. using loops, arrays, lists, functions/ methods and classes (objects)
•	Constructed a program using SQL and C# to allow users to make or take Buzzfeed-type quizzes
•	Created a memory game with HTML, CSS, Javascript and JQuery
•	Built a simplified version of Trello using .net’s MVC, and a Secret Santa app using Rails
•	Used git and GitHub for version control
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Git · jQuery · HTML5 · CSS

positions.title: Middle School Teacher
positions.description: Taught language arts to sixth and seventh graders (reading, writing, vocabulary, grammar, literature study, speaking, etc.). Created and taught Shakespeare on Stage elective. Advised sixth graders. Created and implemented all curriculum used. Chaired professional development committee. Representative to regional professional association (PAISTA). Member of Global Citizenship committee. Organized and chaperoned field trips, including overnights.

positions.title: English teacher
positions.description: Taught English literature and composition to grades nine, ten and twelve. Created and taught electives to twelfth graders (Shakespeare, Children’s Literature, Detective Fiction as Social Critique). Assistant coach cross country and two-time state champion girls’ track team.

volunteerExperiences.description: I created and sent all communications to parents and teachers from the Dorseyville Middle School Parent Teacher Organization including Facebook updates, website updates (Google sites), and weekly emailed newsletters through Mail Chimp.
